stem.text: Which statement about an ammonium ion is correct?

A.text: All of the $\text{H–N–H}$ bond angles in the ion are $90^{\circ}$.

B.text: All of the $\text{H–N–H}$ bond angles in the ion are $107^{\circ}$.

C.text: The ion contains a $\text{N–H}$ dative covalent bond which is weaker than the other three $\text{N–H}$ covalent bonds.

D.text: The ion will react with a base as it is a weak acid.
